title: Visiting Relatives
tips:
・Visiting Relatives status allows **family visits and short-term stays** with Japanese nationals or residents

・Typically granted for **90 days or less** depending on relationship and circumstances

・Application requires documents from both the applicant and sponsor (Japanese relative)

・Check the latest requirements at the [Immigration Services Agency](https://www.moj.go.jp/isa/)
